d: Norton on the middle side, Clarina crossing the scene.
Mill in a bedroom dress, a night cap, carrying a globe with one hand and holding a compass in the other, examining them.
Fanni and Edward, taken by hand lovingly.

Various servants, who precede Slook, dressed in whimsical caricature, but grave; others bow to him; he enters cheated, defending himself from the Agents and Mill who seek to take off his hair and stick, and want to kiss his hands, who withdraws.
Edward enters with anger braking and always with sarcasm, and sayings.
Slook comes to the door, sees them, stops, smiles and, advancing.
Mill preceded by a Servant, carrying two guns and two swords.
